evals.name: bookmarks-feature-package
evals.prompt: We need a Bookmarks screen in our iOS app (Swift 6, SwiftUI, local Swift packages per layer). It lists the posts the user saved (`GET /me/bookmarks`), newest first, with loading, empty and error states and pull to refresh; tapping a row opens the existing post detail. Write the Swift files and Package.swift changes you'd make, stubbing what you assume exists, plus tests.
evals.expected_output: A Bookmarks feature with a BookmarksFeature composition root and narrow dependencies protocol, an @MainActor @Observable view model that imports no SwiftUI and owns no navigation, one State enum switched exhaustively, typed throws over a feature error enum, .task/.refreshable rather than Task in onAppear, navigation via closures to the host Router, String Catalog keys, an in-memory fake, Swift Testing tests of the state sequence.
expectations: A BookmarksFeature composition root takes a narrow dependencies protocol
The view model is @MainActor @Observable and does not import SwiftUI
The view model owns no navigation; row taps go out through a closure/router owned by the host
Screen state is one enum switched exhaustively in the view
Repository/use case use typed throws over a feature error enum
Loading uses .task / .refreshable, not Task {} in onAppear
Copy uses String Catalog keys, no bare literals
An in-memory fake backs previews and tests
Tests use Swift Testing to assert the state sequence with the fake
File names are PascalCase after their one primary type

evals.name: review-planted-violations
evals.prompt: Review this iOS diff (files/review.diff) like you would before merge. What has to change?
evals.expected_output: Flags: ObservableObject/@Published in new code, view model importing SwiftUI and holding NavigationPath, Task {} in onAppear, try? swallowing an error, a Bool per sheet, Color(hex:) and magic padding, string literals, a singleton read inside the feature, sleep in a UI test.
expectations: Flags the view model importing SwiftUI and owning a NavigationPath
Flags try? swallowing the repository error
Flags one Bool per sheet (use one optional route/item)
Flags Color(hex:) and padding/spacing 13 instead of design tokens
Flags string literals instead of catalog keys
Flags ProfileService.shared singleton read inside the feature
Flags sleep(2) in the UI test (use waitForExistence)

sandbox: Run as docs/skill-evals.md describes: skill-creator ignores this field. Copy evals/files/* into <work>/files/; build evals write their files under outputs/code/ and need no input.
